"''Oh. Of course. As a monster does.|Deva Lompop and Boba Fett|}} '''Mos Entha''' was a settlement built across from the [[Mospic High Range]], on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]. During the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] kept [[Slavery|slave]] pens in Mos Entha. At some point, his operations in the town were infiltrated and disrupted by [[Jarm Brock]], who worked for [[Crimson Dawn]]. In response, Jabba sent teams to [[Death|kill]] Brock and his enforcers but these attempts failed, leading the Hutt to hire [[information broker]] [[Deva Lompop]] to work with [[bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett]] in order to complete the job. {{City-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== Mos Entha was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'', which was written by [[Kristin Lund]] and released on [[October 1]], [[2001]]. The settlement was then first mentioned in [[canon]] when elements from ''Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I'' were rereleased as part of the reference book [[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] on [[September 27]], [[2016]]. ==Appearances== *[[Han Solo & Chewbacca 8|''Han Solo & Chewbacca'' 8]] {{Mo}} *''[[Choose Your Destiny: An Escape Mission]]'' {{Mo}} *[[War of the Bounty Hunters – Jabba the Hutt 1|''War of the Bounty Hunters – Jabba the Hutt'' 1]] {{1st}} {{Flash}} ==Sources== *[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] {{1stm}} *''[[Starships and Speeders]]'' *''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Mos Entha |ja=モス・エンサ |pt=Mos Entha }} [[Category:Cities]] [[Category:Hutt Clan cities]] [[Category:Tatooine locations]]
